name: Mel
source:
"Here, there's one. Leave this to me!"

One of the Brides. She is partnered with the teacher [url=/c135518]Clive[/url].

Crushing the enemies with her raging flame, the wielder of "Hellfire." She has outstanding fight skills, dashing across the battlefield with her agile and daring movements.

Cheerful and lively, no opposite personalities so to speak, she is very much a pleasant woman. But she tends to get emotional, a meathead type, not good at using her head. She and Clive have a sibling-like relationship, and he is under her thumb.

She cares about [url=/c135124]Lia[/url], who has just woken up, and also has a good relationship Lia's bearer [url=/c135123]Sreng[/url].

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_07_mel.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her true name is Melty.[/spoiler]
